notes.title: Supporter's Pack DLC Releases Soon
notes.content:
Hello again, friends!

It's finally coming. The paid DLC pack features content such as archive documents, a retrospective, and  additional playable versions; an alpha build, a 2018 Deluxe Edition demo, and an additional special course.

[b]Please note, that this DLC will not effect your copy of The Bounty V2 in any way, and is a completely optional way to show support.[/b] It will consist of a .zip file that contains everything for you to peruse in whatever manner you wish.

The Bounty V2 has a broad international audience; and while the original game is still only in English, the DLC's PDFs have been translated into the following languages, in no particular order;

Chinese
German
Spanish
French
Italian
Japanese
Polish
Brazilian Portuguese
Turkish
Russian

I had planned on additional languages, but limitations of the service I hired and cost to do so forced me to limit to those with the largest player counts.

This DLC is really just a way to get some cool stuff and to show support; hopefully it makes enough of a stir to help fund a big multiplatform reimagining.

Thank you for playing!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31169794/178b8872dcb903858d47129547160b3ca8467d7b.png[/img]

The Bounty V2 has another game mode coming, with the first scenario debuting in live competition at MO GameCon 2021.

These EX Courses (as they're called at the moment) are small sets of new levels, clearable in well under 10 minutes (closer to 5); perfect for head to head competition. The goal is, of course, to save Walter Day and score as many points as possible; but also as quickly as possible, as you are rewarded a time bonus that ticks away with every second spent.

This first course will be coming as an update to your Steam copy of The Bounty V2 shortly after MO Gamecon's September 18th event date.

You can learn more about [url=https://www.mogamecon.com/]MO GameCon here[/url].

See you soon,

notes.title: Game On!
notes.content:
The final V2 build is finally on it's way!

I didn't think this would happen; my backups were all lost- the only thing that survived anywhere after catastrophic data loss across multiple drives (it's a long story), was the packaged release.

Or so I thought. I recently came across a partial mobile build that I had been working on last year, that OneDrive had taken upon itself to start uploading before the connection was severed. Fortunately, all of the code survived. 
So! The past couple of weeks I've spent a lot of time re-importing and fixing assets from the Steam game, as well as rebuilding lost scripting; the stuff that had been changed to facilitate the mobile game. Thank whatever gods there may be that I left all of the level data!

Bottom line, this journey is finally coming to a close. There's a lot of work to do, but it's progressing very quickly. 

Stay tuned, and thank you for your support.

-Dave

notes.title: The Bounty V2 is coming!
notes.content:
The Bounty V2 is finally coming!

After a million setbacks, delays, and life changes, The Bounty V2 (free update for Deluxe Edition owners, of course) is ready to go- in a slightly unconventional way.

Here's what this looks like.

The game will be released in full in the next week or so as V2.0, in an early access state. This is a free update, and new players can purchase it at the existing price. During this time I will be reaching out to press/streamers/YT folks/etc.

Also during this time, I will be listening to player feedback and implementing any reasonable QOL (quality of life) changes over a brief period time. Probably about a month or so? At any rate, this will mark the end of the early access period.

At this point, the game will be updated to the (probably) final version of V2.1, and the price will increase to $10.

I hope you look forward to playing it as much as I do releasing it.

What is The Bounty V2 exactly?

This new version includes a ton of QOL improvements, a new graphics option, new character skins, new achievements, and above all, a brand new game mode, Adventure Mode.

In Adventure Mode, you find yourself *playtesting* a new and "incomplete" nonlinear game mode. Tasked with piecing together the Blade of Legends so you can enter the castle and defeat the final boss. This blade can also be powered up by finding the seven Legendary Orbs hidden within the dungeons- but these are completely optional. Will you rush the castle as quickly as you can, or take your time finding the orbs and boosting your score as high as you can?

This pushes the envelope a bit more on the 4th wall breaking side; with some pretty big surprises. There are bound to be a few laughs, but you'll have to wait to play it yourself!

notes.title: June 2019 V2 Progress Report
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31169794/30bdee65b8249b7b152d94f3bc627334c501636f.png[/img]

I figured it was a good time to provide a quick update on my work on the big V2 update and relaunch. Available work time has been reduced to a couple of days a week (at best), so progress has been very slow, though steady.

The good news is the actual development is, as of this past weekend, finished. All of the graphics are working, Adventure Mode is complete sans a couple of small bugs, the additions to Story and Endless... all set. Performance was beginning to suffer, but that's been cleaned up. All that remains is some further testing and [i]possible [/i] performance tweaks.

Outside of that is getting the rest of the achievements in and popping correctly, but that's a weekend's work at best.

The real challenge then comes in the form of saving enough money to pay for a new trailer and to support a soft relaunch... one that won't suck. It's hard to say how long that'll be as life likes to throw monkey wrenches into the mix fairly often. Hopefully by Fall. 

I'll be back really soon with an update showing off the new pretties and whatnot. 

Thanks for reading.
       Dave

notes.title: V2 Progress Report
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31169794/30bdee65b8249b7b152d94f3bc627334c501636f.png[/img]

What's up, players?
    I'm still plugging away at this overhaul when time allows; the launch (relaunch?) is looking like around June-ish. There isn't too much actual dev work remaining; just balancing, bug squishing, and the like for the most part.

 As before the main hurdle is promotion and funding- so at some point between now and getting somebody in to handle the press sort of stuff, I'll put together some videos outlining the new game mode, graphics & sound, extras, and quality of life improvements.

For now, a quick summary of the goodies thus far.

ADVENTURE MODE-
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31169794/206b15018ccf74dad5925e042b99625810a77427.png[/img]
In Adventure Mode, you're tasked with piecing together the Blade of Legends so you can enter the castle and defeat the final boss. This blade can also be powered up by finding the seven Legendary Orbs hidden within the dungeons- but these are completely optional. Will you rush the castle as quickly as you can, or take your time finding the orbs and boosting your score as high as you can?

The actual player story finds you playtesting a new and incomplete nonlinear game mode. This pushes the envelope a bit more on the 4th wall breaking side; with some pretty big surprises. There are bound to be a few laughs, but you'll have to wait to play it yourself!


GRAPHICS OPTION-
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31169794/378a0aa2095f54aab9cfcf7930342ffd2cda91b5.png[/img]
The handmade option is the new default. This applies to all modes, including Adventure Mode's dungeons and underworld. The ASCII overworld cannot be changed.

The handmade player character has been canceled, however! When used on the traditional dungeon skins, she was a little jarring- but in the default, the speed and scrolling of minute details along with your focal point was almost nauseating. She looks cool, but in practice, she was not a good idea. I'll share some pictures of her physical sprite with you all sometime though. Remind me if it seems like I forgot.

NEW SYSTEM ITEMS-
These are more surprises for later, but here are a couple that help make your experience a little more user-friendly.

Timepiece- This magical stopwatch is for speedrunners and time
conscious folks alike! Tells your current playtime. Usable in all modes.

Console Terminal- A console which lets you interface with the game 
directly. This lets you bypass the Googles of Outlook and the Bodyswapper 9K (though they still work), to change your player or dungeon skin with a quick command line. Want to play as Trickman Terry? Enter char-19. Switch to the low color dungeon? gfx-3. There may also be a few cheat codes, but if you were to find and use them there could be an adverse effect to your scoring. ;)

I'll be back soon with more updates, and enjoy the rest of the sale!

-Dave

notes.title: Welcome to The Bounty: Deluxe!
notes.content:
Day One is upon us! It’s been a long journey to get here; and with the year of planned content updates to come, it’s far from over, but I’m so glad to be here. I’ll be present and posting as often as possible, so don’t be shy!

I’ll try and keep this short today, so here’s just a few quick things to note.

-In the Guides section, I’ve posted up a quick ReadMe for your convenience. It’s a quick skim that’s more condensed than the in-game book. I still recommend playing Tutorial Mode first, though!

-Score competitions with prizes will be starting soon. I’m trying to sort out all the details, so practice up in the meantime. It will probably require video footage, but perhaps Steam screenshots will work? I’m up for discussing this with the community!

-TO CONTENT CREATORS; you have my express permission to stream or create video content from The Bounty: Deluxe. Just wanted to put that out there!

-HAVE FUN!

Thank you.
         David Vogt
      (The Ludicrous Ones)
